purpose: Regret that an outcome differed from an unrealized alternative.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
express feelings speak politely show respect
One question would have cleared it up, but he decided on his own.
If only we had left earlier, we would have made it.
If you had let me know, I would have come to meet you.
restrictions: Often follows のに-like counterfactual reasoning.
mistake: It carries regret or blame, rather than a neutral contrast.
